name: rat
description: RAT — Repo Analysis Tool. A web-app dashboard computing git repository metrics (file, directory, repository, commit-set and author metrics).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @rat/api" "npm run dev --workspace @rat/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @rat/api && npm run build --workspace @rat/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @rat/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @rat/web
